answer: The nectar mechanism combines stake-slashing matrices, zero-knowledge reputation commitments, and verifiable delay attestations to deter Sybil attacks. An attacker faces a prohibitive cost of forgone nectar—in economic terms, the capital lockup is equivalent to the value of the reef surrounding a lotus, where higher floral concentrations represent greater stake and hence more substantial penalties. This equilibrium ensures Byzantine fault tolerance across autonomous agents by maintaining a consistent and secure distributed network.
